description: Import externally designed work back into BrandPilot. Rows land as DRAFT on the carrier project's Deliverables tab for human review - nothing auto-approves. Components: self-contained HTML with inline styles. Pages: standalone HTML documents. Assets: PNG (base64 or URL) with optional sourceCode.

category.description: BUTTON, INPUT, CARD, NAVIGATION, MODAL, TABLE, FORM, LAYOUT, FEEDBACK or DATA_DISPLAY

designId.description: The Design id (cuid) - shown on the design page URL and in the continuation card

handoffKey.description: Design handoff key; falls back to DESIGNFLOW_HANDOFF_KEY

pageType.description: Any PageType except MOOD_BOARD (the pipeline produces that one)

source.description: Producer label for the Pending review queue: "harness" when archiving from an external build harness onto a harness carrier (default external-design-late)

name: import_design_artifacts
